title: LandlordGuard Late Installments: Late Fee Rule and Posting Tool
content:
On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy a late fee is charged once for each installment still unpaid more than the tier's late-fee grace days after its due date, on the day it is found, and is recorded against that installment's term and position. No late fee is charged on a mortgagee-billed term or on a tier whose late fee is 0.00.

## When an installment is late for this purpose

The count runs in calendar days from the installment's due date. Hypothetical illustration with grace days taken as 10: an installment due on 1 March and still unpaid is not yet past the grace days on 11 March (10 days after the due date) and is past them on 12 March (11 days after). Each late installment carries one late fee; a second fee is not charged for the same installment.

## Situation of use and capability

`assess_late_fee_984fd113` charges the late fee for one unpaid installment of a LandlordGuard dwelling policy. One call posts one late-fee entry on the policy's premium account for the named term and installment and raises the premium balance by the fee; the late fee then shows on the premium account.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `assess_late_fee_984fd113`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | the reference id of the landlord dwelling policy record, as returned by the dwelling policy lookup for the verified caller | identifier |
| `term_effective_date` | the start date of the policy term the late installment belongs to, as on the billed installment | YYYY-MM-DD; never empty |
| `installment_number` | the position of the late installment within its term, as shown on the billed installment (1 is the opening installment) | integer 0 to 4 |
| `amount` | the late fee in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places when posted |

## Return

A one-line receipt: "Late fee posted: entry <entry_id> on policy <dwelling_policy_id>, term <term_effective_date> installment <installment_number>, <amount> USD on <posted_date>." The entry id is the new premium-ledger entry, the dates are YYYY-MM-DD, the installment number is the integer position and the amount is shown to 2 decimal places. Receiving this line means the late fee is posted.
